faq.q: What did houses in Hawthorne sell for?
faq.a: 36 houses sold in Hawthorne between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,352,500.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Hawthorne?
faq.a: The median was 20 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.3% of the last list price (11% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Hawthorne sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 36 houses that sold in Hawthorne went for between $1,176,875 and $1,556,250, around a median of $1,352,500.

faq.q: Do houses in Hawthorne sell above asking price?
faq.a: 11% of the 36 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.3% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Hawthorne?
faq.a: The median year built was 1984 for the 36 houses sold in Hawthorne.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Hawthorne usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Hawthorne had 4 bedrooms, from the 36 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

blocks.text: What Hawthorne houses sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

36 houses sold in Hawthorne with a median price of $1,352,500 (the middle half sold between $1,176,875 and $1,556,250), taking a median of 20 days to sell at 97.3% of the last list price; 11% sold above list. They had a median $581 per square foot, a median year built of 1984 and a median lot of 7,200 square feet.
How Hawthorne compares with the rest of Ladner

The median house in Hawthorne sold for $1,352,500, about the same as the Ladner median of $1,340,000 across 117 sales. Hawthorne houses took a median 20 days to sell, against 16 days for Ladner as a whole.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a community is listed only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.
